images.alt: An image of the lower south island, with orange covering otago and northern southland, and yellow over the remainder of mainland southland and parts of fiordland. A orange snow icon sits over inland otago, with an orange rain icon over the coast. A yellow rain icon sits over southland and a yellow wind icon is over fiordland. The orange snow icon has text that says 6am sun - 6am mon, and the orange rain icon has text that reads 6am sun - 9am mon.

post.text:
‼️ A significant rain and snow event for Otago is brewing, with Red Heavy Snow and Heavy Rain Warnings possible ‼️

🌨️ In our latest update, the Orange Heavy Snow and Heavy Rain Warnings for Otago and Northern Southland have been increased to a moderate risk of a Red Warning.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
